mechanism: oracle fixture (task-oracle, 2026-09-05): release the OOD target robot's future assignment edges and let the harness re-solve the MILP on surface=sched.
impl_code:
function OracleReassign!(env)
    rid = ood_event_target()
    rid === nothing && return :no_target
    inv = build_invariant(env)
    edges = release_pending_assignments!(env, inv; agent = string(rid))
    edges isa AbstractVector || return edges
    return (; status = :released, removed = length(edges))
end
